verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs describe federating an existing enterprise directory so employees can sign in to internal and third-party apps with their enterprise credentials. It lists enterprise SSO as a login method alongside AD/LDAP, offers Enterprise Connections and self-service SSO configuration, and references SAML and Google Workspace directory sync, so the core workforce federation capability is first-party. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SAML and OIDC enterprise IdP connection setup, Okta and Entra named as supported IdPs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
